cleanupBasis: Exact archive hashes + current root quiescence; historical closure/qualification not invented. Before deleting, root rechecks roots & readers and retains any newly active/changed source consumer.
compiledProductsPolicy: Every Product/test executable/library/module preserved, including all receipt-bound binaries. Objects/intermediates also preserved because historical job receipts are incomplete; no suffix-only destruction assumption.
roleTagScope: Conservative filename/path/mode inventory, not proof of native compilation. Every regular byte preserved regardless of role tag.
scope: current canonical descriptors compared to archived scratch bytes; conflicts preserved, no repaired receipt/admission
symlinkPolicy: Exact link text archived; verifier/rehydrator never follows or materializes links. Regular target bytes within roots preserved independently.
